home.title: Equity & cap table
home.description: Share classes, plans, securities and stakeholders of each legal entity, with the cap table as of any date, round and exit models, and stock compensation posted to the general ledger.

empty.noEntitiesDescription: Equity is recorded per legal entity. You need access to an active legal entity with a base currency (Company Settings → Subsidiaries).

policy.missing: No equity account policy is in force for this legal entity, so issuances, exercises and stock compensation cannot post.

capTable.emptyClasses: No share classes yet. Record the legal entity's first class under Share classes.
capTable.emptyHolders: No holders yet. Issue shares or awards to put holders on the cap table.

classActions.title: Class {code}
classActions.description: Amendments and splits take effect from their date and are retained with their reason.
classActions.splitHelp: A split restates every holding, award, pool and price of the class from its date, and adjusts the conversion price of preferred classes that convert into it. It must be dated after the latest recorded activity of the class and of those preferred classes.
classActions.conversionClassHelp: The common class the preferred shares convert into from the date. Its splits adjust the conversion price when the class terms say so.

stakeholders.empty: No holders on the cap table yet.

plans.empty: No equity plans yet. Use New plan to record a plan and its reserve.
plans.reserveDescription: A reserve change takes effect from its date. A reduction cannot take the unallocated pool below zero on any later date.
plans.deltaHelp: A negative number removes shares from the reserve.
plans.reserveFailed: The reserve change was not saved.

model.description: Prices a round on the pre-money method against the cap table on the as-of date: outstanding SAFEs and notes convert, protected classes take their anti-dilution shares, and the pool is topped up to its target inside the pre-money. Nothing is recorded.
model.failed: The round could not be modelled.
model.prompt: Enter a pre-money valuation and the new money to price the round against the cap table on the as-of date.

waterfall.failed: The waterfall could not be run.
waterfall.presets: Exit values from the {round} post-money valuation
waterfall.assumptionsHelp: Award assumptions apply to options and RSUs with a vesting schedule.
waterfall.retry: Check the inputs and try again.
waterfall.prompt: Enter an exit value, or pick a multiple of the latest post-money valuation, to see how the proceeds flow.
waterfall.promptNoRound: No priced round in {currency} anchors the presets yet. Enter an exit value to see how the proceeds flow.
waterfall.cascadeHint: In the order proceeds are paid
waterfall.noDecisions: No preferred class or capped SAFE has a choice to make.

decisions.converts: Converts to common for {amount}; keeping its {entitlement} preference would pay {alternative}.
decisions.converts_only: Converts to common for {amount}, more than its {entitlement} preference.
decisions.keeps_preference: Takes its {entitlement} preference; converting would pay {alternative}.
decisions.participates: Takes its {entitlement} preference and shares the rest as converted: {amount} in all.
decisions.participates_capped: Takes its preference and participates up to its {cap} cap: {amount} in all; converting would pay {alternative}.
decisions.participates_capped_only: Takes its preference and participates up to its {cap} cap: {amount} in all.
decisions.safe_converts: Converts for {amount}; cashing out would pay {alternative}.
decisions.safe_converts_only: Converts for {amount}, more than its {entitlement} cash-out amount.
decisions.safe_cash_out: Takes its {entitlement} cash-out amount; converting would pay {alternative}.

waterfall.curveHint: From zero to twice this exit

compensation.replayed: The run through {date} was already posted
compensation.failed: The stock compensation run was not posted.
compensation.empty: No option or RSU awards carry cost through this date.
compensation.runsEmpty: No stock compensation runs posted yet.
compensation.releasesEmpty: No restricted shares vest through this date.

drawer.restrictedFrom: Restricted stock from an early exercise ({basis}) of

help.exercise: Exercise vested units at the exercise price. The resulting share certificate is issued and the cash and the award's grant-date value post to capital.
help.settle: Settle vested units into shares. The award's grant-date value moves from share-based paid-in capital to share capital.
help.forfeit: Unvested units leave the award; the cost recognized for them reverses in the next stock compensation run.
help.expire: Vested, unexercised units lapse. Their recognized cost stays.
help.cancel: Units are cancelled, unvested units first. Cancelling unvested units without a replacement recognizes their remaining cost.
help.repurchase: The company buys shares back into treasury at the amount paid. A Flow may require approval before it applies.
help.transfer: Vested units move to another holder on a new certificate.
help.convert: SAFEs and notes convert at a round's price on its closing date; preferred shares convert into common at the class's conversion ratio.
help.void: Corrects a record entered in error: its entry is reversed on the void date and the event that produced it is undone. A Flow may require approval before it applies.
help.repay: Repay a SAFE at its purchase amount, or a note at its principal and the interest accrued to the date, which accrues first. A note's premium or discount posts to interest expense. A Flow may require approval before it applies.
help.election_83b: Record the date the holder filed an 83(b) election for these restricted shares. The election must be filed within 30 days of the issue date.
help.exerciseEarly: This grant admits early exercise: vested units are exercised first, then the earliest unvested installments. Unvested shares are issued as restricted stock the company may repurchase until they vest; their cash is held as a deposit and released to capital as they vest.
help.repurchaseRestricted: Unvested restricted shares are repurchased on the grant's terms, settling their deposit. Enter the fair market value per share when the grant prices at the lower of cost and fair market value. A Flow may require approval before it applies.
help.cancelConvertible: Cancel the SAFE or note without payment: its principal and accrued interest move to additional paid-in capital. A Flow may require approval before it applies.

events.carryingHint: Carrying amount on the as-of date: {amount}
events.targetClassHint: Defaults to the class's conversion class.

kindHelp.share: Shares issued for cash post the consideration to share capital at par and additional paid-in capital.
kindHelp.option: Options are valued at grant with Black-Scholes; their cost posts through the stock compensation run.
kindHelp.rsu: RSUs are valued at the grant-date share price; their cost posts through the stock compensation run.
kindHelp.warrant: Warrants carry an exercise price; any cash paid for the warrant posts to additional paid-in capital.
kindHelp.safe: The purchase amount posts to the convertible instruments account until the SAFE converts.
kindHelp.note: The principal posts to the convertible instruments account; interest accrues on the note's day count through the interest run until it converts, is repaid or is cancelled.

new.considerationHint: Defaults to the price times the quantity.
new.numberHint: Leave blank to number it automatically.
new.valuationOption: Black-Scholes inputs. The fair value per option is computed and stored with the award.
new.valuationRsu: The grant-date share price is the fair value per unit.
new.conversionPriceHint: Defaults to the original issue price.
new.seniorityHint: Higher seniority is paid first in a liquidation.
new.roundHelp: Record a closed round, then issue its shares and convert its SAFEs and notes against it.
new.mfn: MFN: may adopt a later instrument's better terms
new.earlyExercise: Allows early exercise of unvested units
new.currencyHint: Defaults to the legal entity's currency ({currency}); another currency is measured at the issue-date rate.
new.conversionClassMissing: Record a common class first; preferred shares convert into it.
new.adjustsForSplits: Conversion price adjusts for splits of the conversion class

descriptions.security: Issue shares, an option, an RSU, a warrant, a SAFE or a convertible note to a holder of the legal entity.
descriptions.class: Record a common or preferred share class with its authorized shares and terms.
descriptions.plan: Record an equity incentive plan and the shares it reserves.
descriptions.round: Record a priced financing round; its shares are issued to investors as securities.
descriptions.stakeholder: Add a person or company who holds, or will hold, the legal entity's securities.

new.stakeholderHelp: A stakeholder is a person or company in your directory. After saving, issue their first security to put them on the cap table.

repurchaseBasis.lower_of_cost_or_fmv: Unvested shares repurchased at the lower of cost and fair market value

interest.replayed: The interest run through {date} was already posted
interest.failed: The interest run was not posted.
interest.empty: No convertible note accrues interest through this date.

reversal.title: Reverse the {kind} of {date}
reversal.help: The event's entry is reversed on the reversal date and its units or balance return from that date; history before it stands. Later activity that relies on the event must be reversed first. A Flow may require approval before it applies.

mfn.description: This SAFE may adopt the terms of a convertible instrument issued after it, in its currency, while it is outstanding: a cap where it has none or a lower one, a discount where it has none or a higher one, or post-money conversion. The later instrument's cap, discount and SAFE type are adopted together from the election date.
mfn.noCandidates: No later instrument offers better terms as of {date}.
mfn.adoptHelp: Record the holder's election to adopt the terms of {number}. Conversions from the election date use them. A Flow may require approval before it applies.

approval.submitted: Submitted for approval. It applies when an approver approves it in Approvals.

classes.empty: No share classes yet. Use New share class to record the legal entity's first class.

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.empty: No shares or awards are outstanding on this date.

attention.election83b: {holder} · the 83(b) election for {number} is due by {date} ({days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left)
attention.restrictedDeposit: {holder} · {shares} early-exercised shares of {number} are unvested; the deposit is held until they vest
attention.departed: {holder} left on {date} and still holds {units} option and RSU units; record the forfeitures and expirations
attention.compensationDue: Stock compensation is not posted through {date}: {amount} to post
attention.compensationRefused: Stock compensation through {date} cannot be measured: {message}
attention.interestDue: Note interest is not accrued through {date}: {amount} to post
attention.interestRefused: Note interest through {date} cannot be measured: {message}
attention.pending: {count, plural, one {# equity action awaits approval} other {# equity actions await approval}}
attention.policyMissing: No equity account policy is in force on {date}; nothing can post until one is set up

runs.historyDescription: Runs posted for the legal entity, latest first, with the journal entries they posted.
runs.backdated: Runs are posted through {date}; choose a later period
runs.closeTask: This run is a period close task.
runs.noPeriodsRemedy: Runs post through the end of an accounting period. Generate the fiscal calendar's periods to run stock compensation and note interest.
